title: AntiAFKKick
description: This Plugin doesn't kick you, when you are AFK.
body:
# TeamSMP Anti AFK Kick

  TeamSMP Anti AFK Kick blocks AFK/idle kicks for all players on your Paper server.

  The plugin listens for player kick events and only cancels kicks that match AFK-related patterns (for example `afk`,
  `idle`, `inactivity`, `inaktiv`).
  All other kick reasons are untouched.

  - Protects all players from AFK kicks
  - Pattern-based AFK detection (fully configurable)
  - Optional player notification message
  - Optional console logging for blocked AFK kicks
  - Lightweight and simple setup

  ## Compatibility

  - Server software: Paper
  - API version: 1.21
  - Java: 21

  ## Configuration

  Edit `config.yml` to:
  - Enable/disable the plugin
  - Change AFK match patterns
  - Toggle player notifications
  - Toggle console logs
